root_cause: The corrected profile predicate required network_name, but the server and sidecar creation call sites did not pass it and direct predicate tests did not exercise their invocation contract.
effective_controls: one-run latch prevented evidence laundering by retry
closed envelope preserved the exact failed source and predecessor bindings
ownership-checked recovery removed only the exact Created-state container
clockwork caught the false full Git transcription before publication
protected refs and unrelated untracked files remained untouched
next_direct_controls: spy-signature tests must exercise both real profile predicate call sites
every post-create pre-registry exception must perform exact local cleanup before propagation
machine-resolved Git IDs must be injected or compared mechanically rather than typed
